title: Filter Change Overdue Escalation
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hvacfilter:life
| stats latest(life_pct) as life_pct, latest(days_since_change) as days_since_change by filter_id
| eval overdue=if(life_pct<20 OR days_since_change>120,1,0)
| where overdue=1
| sort - days_since_change
description: Flags filters that are overdue by either condition-based life or elapsed time.
value: Using both clocks catches the cases where the system is lightly used but the filter still sat there too long.
implementation: Ingest filter-life and days-since-change metrics into `index=personal`; alert when either threshold is breached.
visualization: Table of overdue filters with life percentage and days since change.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which HVAC filters have been left too long either because they are worn out or simply too old.
